channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Monty Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Monty Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Monty Williams
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Monty Williams is now on the free agent market, and I know that the Los Angeles Lakers have been like, I don't know what's going on, but I know something's going to happen fast because you got the draft coming up, you got free agency coming up.”

Draymond Green on Monty Williams, Jun 20, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Hart on Monty Williams, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Josh Hart on Monty Williams’ Donte DiVincenzo comments:

“If he didn’t want to be part of the story, he should’ve told his guys to defend better. What else there to say? We’ve got a guy that’s hot. We’re going to try to find the guy that’s hot. That’s common sense in basketball.”

Josh Hart on Monty Williams, Donte DiVincenzo, Mar 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Monty Williams
item.description:
James Edwards III:Weaver on Williams' job so far:

“Monty has this-year pain, but other who have been here have a different level of pain. I'm coming from a different place. He has to learn the team and players.”

Troy Weaver on Monty Williams, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Tom Gores on Monty Williams
item.description:
Gores on Monty Williams:

“I expected what we’ve been seeing these last couple of games. I’m not sure I expected it so fast.”

Tom Gores on Monty Williams, Oct 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Jaden Ivey on Monty Williams
item.description:
Jaden Ivey on Monty Williams:

“He’s coached a lot of great players that I look up to…I’m just gonna continue to trust him. We all love him here. He’s a humble guy. I’m really looking forward to starting this journey with him.”

Jaden Ivey on Monty Williams, Sep 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Monty Williams
item.description:
James Edwards III:Troy Weaver on if Monty Williams could alter Pistons' draft strategy:

“Not really. He's coached for a while ... he knows. He's got great relationships in the league. We hope to leverage that at the appropriate time.”

Troy Weaver on Monty Williams, Jun 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Monty Williams
item.description:
James Edwards III:Troy Weaver on Monty Williams:

“We're excited about today. Monty arriving here is huge because of the work that's been put in from this entire organization, from the business side and basketball side. The belief people have in us restoring the Pistons.”

Troy Weaver on Monty Williams, Jun 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: James Jones on Monty Williams
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:James Jones on the decision to fire Monty Williams:

“A hard decision had to be made about where do we go next…we felt we needed an injection of a different voice, a different energy….as we evaluated where we wanted to go, we just saw a gap, and we needed to fill it.”

James Jones on Monty Williams, Jun 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on a suspension probably coming for Patrick Beverley and how he didn't get involved:

“They're not gonna get me there. Me, it's like I got Monty Williams to answer to at the end of the day. I ain't want him to be disappointed in me for doing that nonsense like that.”

Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams, Patrick Beverley, Nov 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Monty Williams, Erik Spoelstra
item.description:
Cody Taylor:Jimmy Butler on playing against Erik Spoelstra in the All-Star Game:

“I'm glad I get to be with a real coach like Coach Monty Williams over here for a change. No, it's going to be fun. I'm going to talk some trash to him and I can't get in trouble.”

Jimmy Butler on Monty Williams, Erik Spoelstra, Feb 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @CodyTaylorNBA.

item.title: David Fizdale on Monty Williams
item.description:
Ryan Ward:David Fizdale on Monty Williams:

“Total admiration for a human being. ... I've probably stole more from him and the coach out of OKC.... He's a Hall-of-Fame-type coach to me.”

David Fizdale on Monty Williams, Dec 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Chris Paul on Monty Williams, Devin Booker
item.description:
His name was linked to the New York Knicks and the Los Angeles Lakers, but Paul realized he was in the midst of something special and elected to run it back.

“After this season in Phoenix and experiencing how amazing the fans were, my chemistry with my teammates, with [Devin Booker] Book, with Monty [Williams], I knew Phoenix was where I wanted to be,”

Chris Paul on Monty Williams, Devin Booker, Aug 2, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Monty Williams
item.description:
Giannis on Monty Williams pointing out he had more free throws than the entire Suns in Game 3:

“I don't follow quotes after the games from coaches. But I think I take a pretty good beating out there. I have a scratch here and a scratch there. They're making my pretty face ugly.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Monty Williams, Jul 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Chris Paul on Monty Williams
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Chris Paul on his moment with Monty Williams after the game:

“It's emotional. Mont has been through things in his life that a lot of people don't necessarily come back from. The mental stamina, who he is as a person, basketball aside, he means so much to me and my family.”

Chris Paul on Monty Williams, Jun 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Monty Williams
item.description:
Pop on Monty Williams winning the Goldberg Award from the National Basketball Coaches Association as coach of the year:

“Monty did a great job. It was well-deserved and, of course, I am thrilled for him. He did a wonderful job.”

Gregg Popovich on Monty Williams, May 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Chris Paul on Monty Williams
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Chris Paul on Monty Williams being named Coach of the Year by the Coaches Association:

“Absolutely deserves it. I think it means a lot to him too, because those are your peers.”

Chris Paul on Monty Williams, May 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Monty Williams
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Doc Rivers on Monty Williams:

“Monty’s a terrific coach. When you talk to other coaches, who you have to prepare for, who runs good stuff, Monty’s name always comes up. Now, he has talent.”

Doc Rivers on Monty Williams, Apr 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams
item.description:
#SunsDeandre Ayton on Monty Williams hire:

“Sarver says he’s a great guy, so I’ll roll with that...(I know he’s got a lot of experience) working w/big guys. It sounds good. It’s a different beast over here. We’re trying to start something totally different up in in this city.”

Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams, May 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Monty Williams
item.description:
Colangelo said about the five-year deal.

“It starts with that. I think after all the starts and stops, all the adversity, the timing is right for the organization to do what they did. They’ve picked the right guy. There’s good, young talent, draft picks on the board. I just think the clouds have parted a little bit here and I think fans will really take to Monty Williams.”

Jerry Colangelo on Monty Williams, May 7, 2019. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Monty Williams
item.description:
Logan Murdock:Kevin Durant on Phoenix hiring Monty Williams, who was an assistant in OKC during KD’s stint:

“Their whole organization got a great leader to take them to the next level.”

Kevin Durant on Monty Williams, May 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @loganmmurdock.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Monty Williams
item.description:
“He says all the time, 'Whether I'm here or not, I'm going to help you be the best player you can be before we move on or (Williams) moves on,'”

Anthony Davis on Monty Williams, May 13, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Mickey Loomis on Monty Williams
item.description:
“Making a decision like this is never easy and is never done hastily, especially when you are dealing with a person of Monty Williams’ character. We thanked Monty for the tremendous work and commitment he made to our organization and the development of our young players, specifically Anthony Davis,”

Mickey Loomis on Monty Williams, May 12, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tom Benson on Monty Williams
item.description:
“I have the utmost respect for Monty Williams, not only as a coach but as a person,”

Tom Benson on Monty Williams, May 12, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Monty Williams
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Thibodeau on Monty Williams:

“Disappointed. He's a great friend, a great coach and more importantly a great person.”

Tom Thibodeau on Monty Williams, May 12, 2015. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Greivis Vasquez on Monty Williams
item.description:
“It’s a great opportunity for me to develop my game, to develop my leadership skills, and I think this is a chance that I got to take advantage of because Coach Monty Williams really likes my game,”

Greivis Vasquez on Monty Williams, Dec 7, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Monty Williams
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:KD on his exchange with Monty Williams:

“That’s over with. I got a lot of respect for Monty Williams coming from the same area I’m from.”

Kevin Durant on Monty Williams, Nov 17, 2012. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Mickey Loomis on Monty Williams
item.description:
“Monty Williams is bright. He’s got strong core beliefs and a good connection with the players. He’s tough and disciplined and believes in those kinds of things in his program. And I’d say the same things about Dell. The only thing Monty and Dell don’t have is experience.”

Mickey Loomis on Monty Williams, Jul 1, 2012. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.
